fieldsSchema.label: Round stage
fieldsSchema.description: Financing round the company is currently raising, not the Deal lifecycle state.

fieldsSchema.label: Round label
fieldsSchema.description: Optional company wording for a bridge, extension or otherwise unusual round.

fieldsSchema.label: Our role in this round
fieldsSchema.description: Role of the selected Fund in the current financing round. Unset means no role is recorded; neither option implies a committed investment. Review this value if the selected Fund changes.

fieldsSchema.label: Other investors
fieldsSchema.description: Organisations known to be involved in the current financing round, excluding our selected Fund. A link does not assert a signed commitment. Each Organisation appears at most once for this field and has one current role classification.

fieldsSchema.label: Target raise
fieldsSchema.description: Total amount the company aims to raise in this round, recorded as stated with any currency notation; not this firm's intended cheque.

fieldsSchema.label: Indicative investment amount
fieldsSchema.description: Amount our selected Fund is contemplating investing in this Deal's current round, recorded as stated with currency notation; neither the company's target raise nor an investment commitment.

fieldsSchema.label: Instrument
fieldsSchema.description: Proposed investment instrument for our contemplated participation in the current round, recorded in the terms used by the company or Fund; not evidence of agreed terms.

fieldsSchema.label: Valuation
fieldsSchema.description: Company-stated or proposed valuation, recorded as stated with any currency notation; interpret with valuation basis and as-of date.

fieldsSchema.label: Valuation basis
fieldsSchema.description: Whether valuation amount is before or after this financing round.

fieldsSchema.label: Valuation as-of date
fieldsSchema.description: Date on which this valuation was stated or assessed.

fieldsSchema.label: Current term sheet
fieldsSchema.description: Internal pointer to the current term sheet supplied for review; this is an input document, not the generated review.

fieldsSchema.label: Term Sheet Review
fieldsSchema.description: Internal pointer to the latest generated Term Sheet Review artifact; display the linked review rather than the raw ID.

fieldsSchema.label: Screening report
fieldsSchema.description: Internal pointer to the latest generated Screening Report artifact for this Deal; display the linked report rather than the raw ID.

fieldsSchema.label: Evaluation report
fieldsSchema.description: Internal pointer to the latest generated Evaluation Report artifact for this Deal; display the linked report rather than the raw ID.

fieldsSchema.label: IC memo
fieldsSchema.description: Internal pointer to the latest generated IC Memo artifact for this Deal; this memo is not the confirmed human decision.

fieldsSchema.label: Decision Record
fieldsSchema.description: Internal pointer to the latest directly human-confirmed Decision Record. The V3 Assessment Documents group renders a permitted document link, never this raw ID or an independently editable decision field.

fieldsSchema.label: ARR
fieldsSchema.description: Most recent company-stated annual recurring revenue, recorded as stated with any currency notation; not total annual revenue.

fieldsSchema.label: ARR as-of date
fieldsSchema.description: Date to which the company-stated ARR amount applies.

fieldsSchema.label: Monthly net burn
fieldsSchema.description: Company-reported net cash burn per month, recorded as stated with currency notation; interpret with its own reporting period and actual or forecast basis.

fieldsSchema.label: Burn reporting period
fieldsSchema.description: Period and basis for monthly net burn, such as September 2026 actual or a July–September 2026 average; record the company-stated period rather than inferring a single date.

fieldsSchema.label: Cash balance
fieldsSchema.description: Company-reported cash balance, recorded as stated with currency notation; interpret with its own as-of date and do not derive it from burn.

fieldsSchema.label: Cash as-of date
fieldsSchema.description: Date to which the company-reported cash balance applies.

fieldsSchema.label: Source
fieldsSchema.description: Primary route through which this opportunity reached the firm; not a complete origination history. Direct inbound means the company or founder approached the firm directly.

fieldsSchema.label: Introduced by
fieldsSchema.description: Person who introduced this opportunity to the firm, when known. Organisation affiliation is a property of the selected Person, not an alternative target for this field.

fieldsSchema.label: Source details
fieldsSchema.description: Optional context about how this opportunity reached the firm, such as the event and subsequent introduction; not a general Deal notes field or raw source URL.

fieldsSchema.label: Fund
fieldsSchema.description: Stable ID of the Fund explicitly confirmed for this Deal. Optional at creation; displayed in the fixed header and excluded from Field Settings and body groups.

fieldsSchema.label: Previous term sheet
fieldsSchema.description: Internal pointer to an optional previous term sheet supplied for comparison by the Term Sheet Review task; retained for task use but not shown in the default V3 Deal Room layout.

fieldsSchema.label: Decision Record Artifact IDs
fieldsSchema.description: Append-only ordered IDs for explicitly human-confirmed Decision Record artifacts.

fieldsSchema.label: Decision Posture Projection
fieldsSchema.description: Current human-confirmed decision posture projected from the latest Decision Record; do not infer it from a report or transcript.

fieldsSchema.label: Decision Rationale Projection
fieldsSchema.description: Rationale from the latest explicitly human-confirmed Decision Record, shown as a projection rather than an independent decision.

fieldsSchema.label: Decision Conditions Projection
fieldsSchema.description: Conditions from the latest explicitly human-confirmed Decision Record, shown as a projection rather than an independent decision.
